name: london bridge
description: Holding a rope hung from a high point, you walk your hands down it to lean back, then climb back up. It trains the back, arms, grip and core.
instructions: Stand facing a rope hung from a high anchor, feet close to its base.
Grip the rope with both hands, one above the other.
Walk your hands down the rope one at a time, leaning back as your knees bend.
Go as low as you can control.
Climb back up hand over hand to standing.
